title: Kissed Kenyan Rice Sushi
description: A peppery, chewy brunch dish that combines vanilla custard and nigiri-shaped rice on a salt block, inspired by Kenyan flavors.
instructions: Rinse 200g of long-grain parboiled rice until water runs clear.
Cook the rice in 400ml water with 1 tsp salt until fluffy, then let it cool to room temperature.
In a saucepan, whisk together 2 eggs, 200ml milk, 100ml cream, 2 tbsp sugar, seeds of 1 vanilla bean, 1 tsp grated ginger, and 1/2 tsp black pepper.
Gently heat the mixture over low heat, whisking constantly until it thickens into a custard, about 5 minutes.
Remove the custard from the heat, strain it through a fine sieve into a bowl, and allow it to cool to room temperature before refrigerating.
Refrigerate the custard until it sets, about 30 minutes.
Using a small spoon, scoop the cooled rice into 12 equal portions and shape each into a small oblong disk.
Spread a thin layer of the vanilla custard over each rice disk, then place the disks on a chilled salt block.
Press gently to compact the rice and custard together, forming nigiri-like shapes.
Serve immediately, optionally dusting with a pinch of pepper or drizzling a little honey.
